read_extent: Main body and references read previously; all four main figures and Table 1 image inspected September 17; all six supplemental figures inspected; Tables S1/S2 XML text extracted and read, Word layout pending; source workbook structure and all gene identifiers/numeric-cell completeness inspected, not every expression value interpreted.
findings: Exploratory 12-patient expression study, five events reported in the survival model. Authors report severe overfitting (corrected C-index 0.10); no independent survival validation or EMC drug-response experiment. Source workbook has 9,500 unique gene rows versus 9,909 in Methods, without patient outcomes. Figure 3B labels high risk as the better-surviving group; Figure S3 instead associates high scores with shorter survival. Figure 3C and S4 reverse the displayed B-cell direction. These conflicts require reconciliation, not silent relabeling. TYMS-directed treatment is already an author-proposed hypothesis, not a demonstrated sensitivity.
status_check: Targeted web search September 17 found primary records but no correction/retraction notice; not proof that no notice exists.
additional_unresolved_conflicts: Methods defines all six poor-prognosis patients as dying within eight years, but Results reports five events; S3 displays five death markers including one in the good-prognosis group.
TIMER B-cell values differ approximately tenfold between Figure 3C and S4 as well as reversed group direction.
